coverage.authority: 2012. évi I. törvény (Mt.) 102. § (1) and (5), Nemzeti Jogszabálytár
coverage.quote: Munkaszüneti nap: január 1., március 15., nagypéntek, húsvéthétfő, május 1., pünkösdhétfő, augusztus 20., október 23., november 1. és december 24–26.

evidence.observed_facts: Twelve dated observances cover 2027: nine fixed dates plus the three Easter/Pentecost relatives, with 24 December added by 2026. évi LXXII. törvény 3. § (adopted 2026-11-03, promulgated 2026-11-13, in force 2026-11-14). No 2027 workday-transfer decree is in force: Mt. 102. § (5) requires the regulation by 31 October of the preceding year, the 2026 decree (10/2025. (IV. 30.) NGM rendelet) expires 2027-01-01, and three dated secondary sources (2026-09-23, 2026-11-16, 2026-11-17) report that the 2027 decree had not appeared. The official Közlöny search interface is JavaScript-only and returned no readable result to this pass, so the absence is a dated gap, not a proved zero.

verification_questions: Re-check the Magyar Közlöny for a 2027 workday-transfer decree before release and add any substituted workday.

coverage.quote: A tanítási év első tanítási napja 2026. szeptember 1. (kedd) és utolsó tanítási napja 2027. június 18. (péntek).

evidence.observed_facts: The 2026/27 school year covers January-August 2027 with the winter, spring and summer breaks stored; the decree also lets schools move the break boundaries under §7 (4) and lets minority schools differ under §7 (5).

verification_questions: Confirm the 2027/28 first teaching day when its decree is issued and close the summer break end.

coverage.authority: 1/2026. (VII. 31.) OGYM rendelet covers only the 2026/2027 tanév

evidence.observed_facts: No 2027/2028 tanév rendje decree is issued as of 2026-11-26; the autumn break that falls in October 2027 is therefore uncovered rather than assumed, and no school closure is claimed for 1 September-31 December 2027.

coverage.note: Uncovered interval: the 2027/28 tanév rendje decree is normally issued in the summer before that school year.
